server.note: Vite announced http://localhost:5173/, the same as the resolved base_url. Started from D:/personal/Photo/composition with npm run dev -- --port 5173 --strictPort. Stopped with TaskStop and doctor.mjs stop (free_after: true). Desktop checks were driven in the Playwright MCP Chromium browser at 1280x800. AC-5.10 and AC-5.14 and the mobile sweep were driven in real WebKit with the iPhone 13 device profile, by a Node script in the scratchpad that uses the project's @playwright/test against the same server.
